\]

\[

\[
P(\text{3 heads}) = \frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total number of outcomes}} = \frac{1}{8}
\]

\[
\left| \frac{3}{8} - \frac{1}{8} \right| = \frac{3}{8} - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{2}{8} = \frac{1}{4}
